meta.title: {name} — Cafe & Restaurant in Wolaita Sodo
meta.description: A popular cafe and restaurant beside the main road in central Wolaita Sodo, Ethiopia. Authentic Wolaita raw meat (ጥሬ ስጋ), Shekla Tibs, Kitfo, coffee and more. Open daily 7 AM – 9 PM. Rated 4.7 on Google.

hero.sub: A popular dining and social spot right beside the main road in the centre of Wolaita Sodo — authentic Ethiopian and Wolaita cuisine, fresh coffee, and an atmosphere that invites you to stay.

steps.title: Roasting
steps.text: Green beans are roasted over the flame until they crackle and darken, filling the room with aroma.

steps.title: Brewing
steps.text: The fresh grounds are brewed in a clay jebena until the coffee rises — rich, dark and strong.

steps.title: Serving
steps.text: Poured from a height into small cups and shared. Sit down, slow down, stay a while.
